name: @oc/runtime-flue
description: Durable Agent Sessions (v3) flue runtime image (design 012 §11.6). Hosts a USER-BUILT flue artifact (a self-contained ESM bundle whose entry calls @opencomputer/flue's serveOC) as an OC brain behind the v3 runtime contract. Same adapter shape as claude/codex/pi: a per-turn OC-aware driver (adapter-core) + a resident OC-unaware brain — except the brain is the artifact, not baked into the image. This package ships ONLY the adapter-side consumer: a RuntimeSpec (FlueEvent v:3 → OC taxonomy translation, mcp subset, sources note), a launcher that resolves + imports the materialized artifact, and the aggregated-skills-mount helper. It NEVER links @flue/runtime — it knows flue's wire shapes, not its code, which is why it hosts whichever artifact lands in it.

scripts.test: npx -y tsx test/translate.test.ts && npx -y tsx test/skills-mount.test.ts && npx -y tsx test/launcher.test.ts && npx -y tsx test/cursor.test.ts && npx -y tsx test/fixture-smoke.test.ts
